svg.text: github.com/frascella-dev/tdm-dash · generated by hardware/drawings/generate.py from hardware/drawings/perfboard.py, do not edit by hand
Seen from the component side: harness connectors on the left edge,
Pico USB at the right edge. One zone per schematic sheet.
J101 (6 pins), J102 (4 pins): adapter harness
Q101 IRF4905 lying flat · R101 10k · D101 12 V
U101 Pololu D36V28F5 in a socket · D103 1N5819 · C103 470 µF
D301 1N4007 · R301, R302 22k 1 W, raised off the board
U301 H11L1 in a socket · R304 4.7k · C302 100 nF
U602 FRAM breakout on an 8-pin header
J103 (2 pins): 5 V to the Pi
5 channels, each: EL817 in a socket, 10k, 1N4148,
100 nF and 4.7k (3.3k for neutral); outputs to GP6–GP10
C501–C503 100 nF · D501–D503 BAT54S on SOT-23 adapters
J601 buttons · J501 TEMT6000 · J701 to the TPS61169 breakout
U601 on 2 × 20 headers: columns 10–29, rows Q and X
USB pair on the TP2/TP3 pads under the Pico (J702)
F101 inline fuse (adapter harness) · U701 TPS61169 next to the Kippah ·
SW601, SW602 and the TEMT6000 on the enclosure · sheet 8, backup
